signup.title: Sign-up Agreement
signup.html:
I confirm that:

  1. I am 18 years of age or older, and the date of birth I entered is true.
  2. I have read and agree to the SuiteFace Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including individual arbitration and the class-action waiver (I may opt out within 30 days).
  3. SuiteFace does not guarantee or promote any relationship, match or outcome. My membership is at will.
  4. SuiteFace does not run criminal background checks on members.
  5. Meeting strangers carries risk, and harm can happen. I accept that risk. I will meet in public places, tell someone where I am going, arrange my own transportation, never meet in a private place for a first date, and call 911 in an emergency.
  6. I have never been convicted of a violent or sexual crime and am not required to register as a sex offender.
  7. Everything I put on my profile is true, I created it myself, and I will keep only one account.

buyin.title: Buy-In and Membership Agreement
buyin.html:
1. I authorize SuiteFace Inc. to charge $21.00 today for my Buy-In, which includes my first 30 days.
  2. I authorize a recurring charge of $2.10 every month, starting 30 days from today, until I cancel. I can cancel anytime online in Settings.
  3. A pause longer than 21 days ends my membership, and returning requires a new $21.00 Buy-In.
  4. Charges are non-refundable except where the law requires.
  5. Contact with other members requires an active paid membership.

lobby.title: Joker Maker Lobby Entry Agreement
lobby.html:
1. This $210.00 buys one entry to the Joker Maker Lobby. It is an access fee only.
  2. It does not purchase, guarantee or influence any Joker, and it is non-refundable for any reason, including if I make no Joker or a Joker is challenged or removed.
  3. I may only make Jokers about SuiteFace members, from my own first-hand experience.
  4. Safety concerns belong in Report a safety concern, not the lobby.

attest.title: Joker Attestation
attest.html:
About the member named in my Joker, I swear that:

  1. This Joker is true and comes from my own first-hand, direct experience with this member, not from rumor or anyone else's account.
  2. I did not create this member's profile or account, I did not help anyone create it, and I have no knowledge of a friend or any other person creating it in order to target this member.
  3. I discovered this member's card on SuiteFace on my own, while viewing my deck (my best hand) or while searching in the Joker Maker Lobby.
  4. I am not acting with, or on behalf of, anyone else, and this is not retaliation for a Joker or report made about me.
  5. The reasons I selected and my statement are accurate, and any evidence I upload is genuine and unaltered.
  6. I take full ownership of this Joker and its claims. I understand I may be legally responsible if it is false, and I agree to defend and repay SuiteFace Inc. for any claim that results.
  7. If any of this is untrue, SuiteFace may remove the Joker, close my account and keep any fees I paid.
